props.name: preferred form: chromic acid on zinc carbonate, pellets, reduction, usual synthesis

evidence.quote: its preferred form zinc carbonate or basic car- bonate is treated with chromic acid in aque- ous solution, the product is dried and brought into a suitable form e. g. pellets for introduc- tion into a converter where it is exposed to
a gaseous mixture containing carbon mon- oxide and hydrogen. After reduction of the catalyst, the synthesis of methanol may be carried on in the usual manner.

props.statement: In the preferred form, zinc carbonate or basic carbonate is treated with chromic acid in aqueous solution, dried and formed (e.g. pellets) for a converter where it is exposed to carbon monoxide and hydrogen; after reduction the methanol synthesis is carried on in the usual manner.

props.name: Zn:Cr 9:1 particularly effective

evidence.quote: Such catalysts aré particularly effective when the molecular ratio of zinc to chromium is nine to one (Zn: Cr).

props.statement: Such catalysts are particularly effective when the molecular ratio of zinc to chromium is nine to one.

props.name: composition varies; final product must be tested for the 9:1 ratio

evidence.quote: and in making my preferred -cata- lyst (having a ratio Zn: Cr of 9:1) it is neces- sary to test the final product to be sure that the desired ratio has been obtained and if not, the preparation must be repeated.

props.statement: The composition of the precipitate varies with slight changes in the preparation conditions; in making the preferred 9:1 Zn:Cr catalyst the final product must be tested and the preparation repeated if the ratio is not obtained.

props.name: a zinc carbonate is a very good basis for Zn-Cr catalysts

evidence.quote: I have now discovered that a very good

way to prepare these catalysts is to employ zine carbonate or basic zine carbonate as a basis for the preparations of zinc-chromium compositions, especially by the reaction be- tween the zinc carbonate or basic zinc carbon-
ate. and a soluble chromium compound.

props.statement: A very good way to prepare zinc-chromium catalysts is to use zinc carbonate or basic zinc carbonate as the basis, especially by reacting it with a soluble chromium compound.
